clips.title: Weapon swing — quick swish
clips.prompt: A single fast wooden fighting staff swung hard through empty air. Clean dry airy swish, a rising soft shhhh and a sharp whipping fwoosh, rapid acceleration then fading air turbulence. Short isolated martial arts weapon swing, close microphone. Air movement only, no contact or impact, no metallic ringing, no voice, no music, no background.

clips.title: Weapon swing — broad swish
clips.prompt: One broad smooth wooden bo staff sweep cutting through air from left to right. A soft airy whoosh that swells quickly into a clear wide shhhh-woosh and tapers away smoothly. Dry isolated close-up weapon movement, less than half a second, air friction only. No hit, no thud, no snap, no metallic clang, no voice, no music, no ambience.
